born.why: The code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between novel, ambiguous, and known fruits; it tastes novel fruits only when hunger is manageable to gather data without risk of death, avoids confirmed poisons, and exploits safe foods aggressively (eating if hungry, carrying if full) while using statistical confidence from the diary to make safer decisions.
